facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A toad took her. She was on a leaf. She was scared. She floated away.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: One night, a big ugly toad stole little Thumbelina. She woke up on a lily pad in the middle of a pond. The toad wanted her to marry her son. She floated away on the lily pad crying for help. Tiny fish felt sorry for her and nibbled the stem. The lily pad broke free and carried her down the stream.
facts.Word cards: toad = 두꺼비 / sleeping = 자고 있는 / scary = 무서운 / took = 데려갔다
